text:
Lina: Quick thread to lock GA gate for Keepalive feature. We need final owners for SLA verification, billing-smoke, docs, canary, and runbooks. Who can take each?
Raj: I'll take SLA validation and synthetic load runs. Propose p99 < 220ms for hosted GA, error rate <0.05% sustained.
Priya: I'll own docs and customer-facing pricing examples. I need a sample invoice and a short howto for Dedicated customers.
Dan: I'll coordinate canary with SRE. Suggested cadence: 5% x12h, 25% x12h, 50% x12h, then 100% if no regressions. Canary cutoff if p99 >250ms or errors >0.2%.
Lina: Owners: Raj=SLA/tests, Priya=docs+pricing, Dan=canary+oncall handshake. Ops: create tickets and set canary schedule please. @ops-bot
ops-bot: Tickets created: INF-4999 (SLA tests), INF-5000 (Canary plan), INF-5001 (Billing smoke). Links: https://go/infra/INF-5000
Raj: Test plan summary: 1) synthetic: 60k QPS sustained for 30m, measure p95/p99 and CPU/GPU tails. 2) mixed-e2e: replay 24h production mix at 20k QPS. Acceptance: p99 <=220ms and CPU tail <85%.
Priya: Billing-smoke checklist (short):
```
- Run billing sample for short/med/long seq (16, 256, 2048)
- Verify token pricing under tariff V2
- Assert invoice line items: model, tokens, storage, dedicated surcharge
- End-to-end: create trial org -> generate 100 requests -> check invoice entries
```
Priya: billing-smoke cURL (for test org):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer test_XXXX" \
  -d '{"model":"keepalive-base","input":"hello","max_tokens":16}'
```
Dan: Canary knobs to add: fallback route to "keepalive-stable" for 1% traffic, traffic ramp script, canary-decision checklist in runbook. I'll add auto-rollback if error spike >0.5% for 5m.
Raj: Observability ask: per-model p99, traffic split, KV-cache hit rate, request-length distribution, token-cost estimate per request. Add a regression alert wired to eval harness comparing a control prompt set.
Priya: Docs timeline: draft pricing examples + howto by Fri EOD, final by next Wed. Will ping finance-bot for sample invoice template.
finance-bot: Sent sample invoice template to Priya. Also: pricing checklist includes per-seq breakouts and example monthly cost for 100k reqs.
Lina: Runbook minimum (to be short):
```
- Pager list + escalation order
- Canary traffic script + rollback command
- Quick mitigation steps (throttle, fallback model switch)
- How to validate billing anomalies
- Post-GA check (48h stability report)
```
Dan: SRE note: we need a warm-up window before canary to populate KV caches. Recommend a 1h warmup at 2% traffic.
Raj: Load test infra note: will run on staging cluster with perf env matching GA config. Will post results and raw json reports here. Pass = green all metrics + no OOMs.
Priya: Also adding a short "pricing smoke" runbook snippet into user docs so customers know expected billing after GA.
Lina: Decision checklist to mark GA:
- SLA tests green (Raj)
- Billing-smoke completed and invoice sanity checked (Priya + Finance)
- Canary executed with no rollbacks and stability for 48h (Dan + SRE)
- Runbook and user docs published (Priya)
- Dashboards + regression alerts live (Raj)
If any item fails -> hold GA and trigger rollback runbook.
Raj: Scheduling synthetic runs for tomorrow morning. Will post timestamps.
Dan: I'll schedule canary and tag oncall rotation. Warmup + ramp scripts landing this afternoon.
Priya: Starting docs now, will loop in product-reviewers for sign-off.
Lina: Thanks everyone. If anything looks risky, flag here and we'll delay. :thumbsup:
